Haddonfield, Camden County, New Jersey, United States of America

notes: PROBABLE MISSING LINK IN THE SPINE (research 2026-07-03): son of John Albertson & Ann Pine ('Josiah (s John and Ann)' at Haddonfield MM), married ABIGAIL C. HODSON (1801-1876, d. Thomas and Mary) on 21 Mar 1822 at Haddonfield MM; died 1849; both buried Haddonfield Friends Cemetery (Find A Grave 206035580, which names his father John Albertson 1771-1842). Probable father of Isaac J Albertson (1824-1896, I182195862458) — see Isaac's record for the evidence; if confirmed, this man belongs in the direct line between John and Isaac, and the export's John->Isaac link skips him.
Documented daughter: Mary Ann Albertson m. Charles P. Redman 14 Oct 1853 ('d. Josiah & Abigail', Craig's Camden Co. marriages); aggregated data credits the couple with ~5 children born 1825-1834.
